hints.title: Directed Order Graph
hints.text: Model the pairs of letters as directed edges indicating ordering in the supersequence.

hints.title: Cycle Elimination via Duplication
hints.text: Doubling a character breaks all cycles passing through it, placing one instance at the front and one at the back.

hints.title: Feedback Vertex Set Search
hints.text: Find minimum subsets of characters to double such that the remaining induced subgraph is a DAG.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Enumerates doubled subsets by increasing cardinality and verifies DAG property using bitwise Kahn algorithm.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full supersequence search has factorial branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask adjacency representations enable rapid bitwise cycle checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Connects shortest supersequence of length-two pairs to feedback vertex set on directed graphs.
